name: Framer
tagline: Framer is a website builder aimed at designers who want pixel-perfect results without engineering support. Its AI site generator creates a full design from a prompt, and the visual editor gives designers fine control over animations, responsive breakpoints, and interactions. Agencies and design-led startups use Framer for marketing sites that genuinely stand out.
